name: UWR - Thiruvananthapuram
shortDesc: Robotics makerspace for kids and teenagers with great facilities for Ai and Robotics

name: Integrated Startup Complex & Super Fab Lab
shortDesc: Fabrication lab with 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC milling and other facilities for prototyping and manufacturing

name: Maker Village
shortDesc: India's largest Electronic Incubator & ESDM facility under the aegis of MeitY, Govt of India with IIITM-K as implementation agency.

name: Kochi Robotics Club
shortDesc: Provides STEM education based on robotics, engineering, automation, sustainable and renewable energy. They provide courses for kids

name: Space Museum (ISRO-VSSC)
shortDesc: major space research centre of ISRO, focusing on rocket and space vehicles for India's satellite programm. Museum containing real rocket components, spacecraft models, launch vehicle exhibits, and interactive displays

name: Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology (IIST)
shortDesc: Started by ISRO to nurture space science and technology talent in India. Public events such as open days, exhibitions, and lectures are sometimes organised.

name: HAL Heritage Centre and Aerospace Museum
shortDesc: howcases India's aviation and aerospace history through retired aircraft, helicopters, jet engines, flight simulators, and interactive exhibits. Operated by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)

name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC-SHAR) Visitor Complex
shortDesc: SRO's primary spaceport and the launch site for nearly all of India's orbital space missions. They organise public veiwing sessions for the visitors to see launches from a safe distance

name: Regional Science Centre and Planetarium
shortDesc: Large planetarium and science centre with interactive exhibits, science shows, and educational programs. Science gallerys, activity corners, aquatic life corners, science parks and more for students and those interested to explore.

name: Vijnan Sagar Science and Technology Park
shortDesc: Educational destination with interactive physics and chemistry labs allowing students to conduct experiments and learn scientific principles. It also includes an ISRO pavilion showcasing space technology and satelite models.

name: Indian Institute of Science (IISc) & CeNSE
shortDesc: One of indias top research institutes featuring nanotechnology and microprocessor technology labs (CeNSE) and top deep-tech labs. Campus visits are restricted and require prior approval, except during the massive annual Open Day...
